name: Disable PCIe Link State Power Management
description: Disables PCIe Link State Power Management to reduce power-saving transitions that can introduce small latency spikes.

description_i18n.en: Disables PCIe Link State Power Management to reduce power-saving transitions that can introduce small latency spikes.
description_i18n.de: Deaktiviert das PCI Express-Link-Zustands-Energieverwaltung, um Energieeinsparungsübergänge zu reduzieren, die kleine Latenzspitzen verursachen können.
description_i18n.fr: Désactive la gestion de l'état du lien PCIe pour réduire les transitions d'économie d'énergie qui peuvent introduire des pics de latence.

warnings.title: Power behavior change
warnings.message: Power behavior may change, which can affect battery life, heat, or fan noise

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Modifies the ACPI power settings for PCI Express ASPM (Active State Power Management) by setting the Current AC and DC values to index 0 This changes how Windows handles link state transitions on supported hardware
